newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Access Health cut.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Access Health cut.

text.p: -- Smith Barney downgraded Access Health Inc and PHP Healthcare Corp to neutral from buy, according to a Smith Barney source.
-- Access fell 7-3/4 to 14-3/4. On Tuesday, Access said it expects full-year 1997 earnings to be $0.15-$0.17 per share below the consensus estimate of $0.99 per share.

-- PHP dropped 1-1/8 to 16. PHP said late Tuesday it will report a third-quarter loss resulting from charges that include the divestment of the long-term care business within its government managed care division.
